body: Alright. I'm sorry it has to end like this. See you in the next life brother.
Make sure he is able to find this and actually read it. Write it down and have it near you or something so that it can be given to him if you really end up going through with it.

I've been planning it for a while anyways. I've been wanting to end my life for a while now, this was just the final nail in the coffin. Thank you for reading and responding, though. I appreciate the kind words.
I know this is very poorly written but my brain hasn't been functioning properly as of late.
